# Office Hours
 
```{r packages-data, include=FALSE} 
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lubridate)
library(glue)
library(googlesheets4)
office_hrs <- read_csv("class_data/office-hours.csv", show_col_types = FALSE,
                     col_types = list(.default = col_character())) 

study_halls <- read_csv("class_data/study-halls.csv", show_col_types = FALSE,
                     col_types = list(.default = col_character())) 
```
  
  

  
```{r build-oh-table, eval = TRUE, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
tbl.oh <- office_hrs |>
  kbl(escap = FALSE, align = "lllll", table.attr = 'class="schedule-table"') |>
  kable_styling() |>
  column_spec(1:4, width = "20%", extra_css = "padding-right: 20px;") |>  
  column_spec(5, width = "60%")

  cat(tbl.oh)
```
  

# Study Halls
 
```{r build-sh-table, eval = TRUE, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
tbl.sh <- study_halls |>
  filter(confirmed == "X") |>  
  select(name, day, start_time, end_time, location) |>
  rename(Name = name, Day = day, `Start Time` = start_time, `End Time` = end_time, Location = location) |>  
  kbl(escap = FALSE, align = "llll", table.attr = 'class="schedule-table"') |>
  kable_styling() |>    
  column_spec(1:4, width = "20%", extra_css = "padding-right: 20px;") |>  
  column_spec(5, width = "60%") 
     
  cat(tbl.sh)
```
